details: Bitcoin (BTC) has broken above the $80,000 mark for the first time since May, extending a powerful rally with over 20% gains. This upward movement is primarily driven by strong institutional demand, with spot Bitcoin ETFs recording approximately $1.9 billion in net inflows last week. A significant short squeeze also contributed to the price surge, liquidating over $4 billion in bearish positions. Ethereum (ETH) has mirrored the positive sentiment, holding above $2,500 after a nearly 30% rally. Solana (SOL) surged towards $100, benefiting from accelerated institutional interest and ETF demand. Macroeconomic factors, including shifts in U.S. Treasury policy, are also cited as contributing to a more favorable environment for risk assets.
